title: Bill Belichick praises Rob Gronkowski for 'well-deserved' induction into Patriots Hall of Fame: 'Proud of Rob and what he's accomplished'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bill Belichick praises Rob Gronkowski for 'well-deserved' induction into Patriots Hall of Fame: 'Proud of Rob and what he's accomplished'
sources.description: Gronkowski, who was honored in an induction ceremony on Saturday, won 3 Super Bowls alongside Belichick during the tight end's nine-year stint with New England.
